summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in the run_app entry point's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests; all pass on Python 3.9 (module runs in about 1s and exits on its own). Not committed. Caveats: my first full-module run hung past the 120s limit and I could not reproduce it; 11 related existing tests fail with "async def functions are not natively supported" (pytest-asyncio missing in this environment, not verified against an unmodified checkout); Python 3.7 compatibility is unverified.
